dispositions.rationale: No existing occurrence states the antipodal coincidence theorem.
Nearby convergence and Radon-Nikodym records do not construct a measure from a premeasure.
Class-group finiteness and Hecke L-functions do not state the residue formula.
The exact positive-integer orbit claim is absent.
The regular one-parameter scalar bound is absent.
Lagrange and Abel-Ruffini are unrelated to the invariant-factor classification.
The elementary number-theory sequence lacks the four-square representation theorem.
Use the precise equivalence-of-coherent-sheaves statement rather than the GAGA slogan.
The name denotes distinct general and commutative C*-algebra representation theorems.
Lefschetz fixed point is not the tangent-vector-field obstruction.
Hilbert's sixteenth problem has two logically independent parts and is not one proposition.
Compactness entries do not imply the open-image theorem for injective maps.
The constant-Jacobian polynomial inverse claim is absent.
Existing compactness and fixed-point rows do not state plane separation.
This extension theorem strictly strengthens the Jordan curve conclusion and is not an alias.
Zero-one and continuity theorems do not construct a process from consistent marginals.
Noetherianity and Jordan-Hölder are adjacent but distinct decomposition results.
Vitali covering and maximal inequalities are inputs, not this a.e. conclusion.

THM-M-0132 is a broad historical-conjecture occurrence; THM-M-0518 is the semistable specialization and THM-M-0519 is still source prose. A new exact child freezes the all-elliptic-curves-over-Q theorem without assigning truth credit to those inherited rows. THM-M-0133 is a proof event and THM-M-0387 is FLT, neither is the same claim.
No existing statistics row states the most-powerful likelihood-ratio result.
THM-M-1004 already supplies the 可选停时定理 occurrence. Its prose remains too broad for unconditional truth credit, but candidate overlap does not justify minting a duplicate family.

THM-M-0398 and THM-M-0399 identify the correct Diophantine family but their inherited prose does not freeze the exponent, quantifiers or denominator conditions. A new exact child carries the proved status. ATV-00000974 is the distinct combinatorial Roth theorem and remains a hard negative.
The transcendence-degree lower bound is absent.
Riemann-Roch records do not state the perfect cohomological pairing.
The weak-star compactness theorem is absent and is unrelated to the Banach fixed-point theorem.

Use a dominated statistical experiment; an unrestricted density-free slogan is unsafe. Fisher 1922 supplies historical provenance, while Halmos-Savage supplies the measure-theoretic dominated-experiment generalization used here.

Conditional-expectation risk improvement is absent and distinct from ATV-00001112 Blackwell renewal. The exact_v1 correction freezes a standard-Borel model, an R^d-valued integrable estimator and an explicit parameter-independent sufficient kernel so conditional expectation and Jensen's inequality are defined.
Complete sufficiency plus unbiasedness yielding the unique UMVU estimator is absent.
Use the full-rank homoscedastic uncorrelated linear model; omit neither BLUE nor covariance ordering.
Uniform almost-sure convergence of the empirical CDF is absent.
The traditional name bundles two implications with different hypotheses.
The finite-dimensional C1 local diffeomorphism theorem is absent.
The finite-dimensional C1 local graph theorem is absent.
The catalog's group section omits the homomorphism quotient theorem.
The subgroup-normal-subgroup quotient comparison is absent.
The iterated quotient theorem is absent.
Burnside orbit counting does not replace orbit-stabilizer.
The finite-group conjugacy class equation is absent.
This is an open realization problem, not the fundamental theorem of Galois theory.
Use the geometric p-adic representation formulation and do not conflate it with automorphy consequences.
Use the weak general-type non-density formulation; stronger exceptional-locus formulations remain separate.
The Grothendieck standard conjectures are a package, not one truth-apt proposition.
A Hadamard matrix is an entity definition; the open claim is existence in every positive order divisible by four.
Freeze the n-moving-runners plus stationary-observer indexing to avoid the common n versus n+1 ambiguity.
The three-unit-fraction representation claim is absent.
Exclude the degenerate family whose union is empty and state the half-frequency threshold.

Use the smooth-projective finite-field cycle-class surjectivity variant; other base fields are separate variants. Milne supplies the general finite-field formulation, while Tate 1966 is retained only as primary evidence for the abelian-variety case.
Include irreducibility, positivity, admissibility, degrees and the Euler-product constant.
This is the Mahler-measure gap conjecture, not ATV-00000498 Lucas-Lehmer primality testing.
The plane unit-distance chromatic-number problem is distinct from ATV-00000862 Hadwiger's graph-minor conjecture.

statement.natural_language: 每个连续映射 f:S^n→R^n 都在一对对跖点取相同值。
hypotheses: n is a positive integer
f:S^n→R^n is continuous
statement.conclusion: There exists x∈S^n such that f(x)=f(−x).
statement.scope: Euclidean n-sphere and finite-dimensional real codomain.

material_status.basis: Classical theorem in the cited primary paper.

aliases: 卡拉泰奥多里扩张定理
卡拉西奥多里扩张定理

statement.natural_language: 代数上的 σ-有限预测度唯一扩张为其生成 σ-代数上的测度。
hypotheses: A is an algebra of subsets of Ω
μ₀:A→[0,∞] is a premeasure
μ₀ is σ-finite
statement.conclusion: There exists a unique measure μ on σ(A) with μ restricted to A equal to μ₀.
statement.scope: Existence-plus-uniqueness variant; σ-finiteness is imposed for uniqueness.

material_status.basis: Standard measure-extension theorem with the uniqueness hypothesis made explicit.

aliases: 戴德金 ζ 函数留数公式

statement.natural_language: 数域 K 的戴德金 ζ 函数在 s=1 的留数由类数、调节子、单位根数和判别式给出。
hypotheses: K is a number field with signature (r₁,r₂)
h_K,R_K,w_K and d_K denote its class number, regulator, number of roots of unity and discriminant
statement.conclusion: Res_{s=1} ζ_K(s)=2^{r₁}(2π)^{r₂}h_KR_K/(w_K√|d_K|).
statement.scope: Full number-field formula under the standard regulator normalization.

material_status.basis: Classical analytic class number theorem.

statement.natural_language: 从任意正整数出发，偶数除以 2、奇数变为 3n+1 的反复迭代最终到达 1。
hypotheses: n is a positive integer
T(n)=n/2 for even n and T(n)=3n+1 for odd n
statement.conclusion: There exists k≥0 such that T^k(n)=1.
statement.scope: All positive integers; no probabilistic or density weakening.

material_status.basis: The cited survey states the unsolved 3x+1 problem; no accepted general proof is known.

statement.natural_language: 在正则单参数模型中，g(θ) 的任意无偏估计量的方差至少为 (g′(θ))²/I(θ)。
hypotheses: {p_θ} is a regular dominated one-parameter model with θ-independent support
differentiation may pass under the integral
T is square-integrable and E_θ[T]=g(θ)
statement.conclusion: Var_θ(T)≥(g′(θ))²/I(θ).
statement.scope: Scalar unbiased-estimation form; biased and matrix forms are separate variants.

material_status.basis: Classical information inequality under explicit regularity assumptions.

additions.preferred_label: Structure theorem for finitely generated abelian groups
aliases: 有限生成阿贝尔群结构定理
有限生成阿贝尔群分类定理

statement.natural_language: 每个有限生成阿贝尔群唯一分解为自由部分与满足整除链的有限循环群直和。
hypotheses: G is a finitely generated abelian group
statement.conclusion: There are unique r≥0 and unique integers 1<n₁|⋯|n_k such that G≅Z^r⊕Z/n₁Z⊕⋯⊕Z/n_kZ.
statement.scope: Invariant-factor form; uniqueness is up to the displayed numerical invariants.

material_status.basis: Classical module-over-a-PID structure theorem.

statement.natural_language: 每个非负整数都是四个整数平方之和。
hypotheses: n is a nonnegative integer
statement.conclusion: There exist a,b,c,d∈Z with n=a²+b²+c²+d².
statement.scope: Zero is allowed; some of the four integers may be zero.

material_status.basis: Classical theorem; the cited formal reference exposes a checked exact statement.

aliases: 代数–解析几何比较定理

statement.natural_language: 复数域上的射影概形的相干代数层与其解析化上的相干解析层由解析化函子给出等价。
hypotheses: X is a projective scheme over C
statement.conclusion: Analytification Coh(X)→Coh(X^{an}) is an equivalence of categories.
statement.scope: Coherent-sheaf equivalence form; individual cohomology-comparison consequences are not counted again.

material_status.basis: Serre's GAGA theorem.

aliases: 盖尔范德–奈马克表示定理

statement.natural_language: 每个 C* 代数都有一个到某个希尔伯特空间上有界算子代数的忠实等距 *-表示。
hypotheses: A is a C*-algebra
statement.conclusion: There exist a Hilbert space H and an injective isometric *-homomorphism A→B(H) whose image is norm closed.
statement.scope: General, possibly noncommutative representation theorem.

material_status.basis: Gelfand-Naimark representation theorem.

aliases: 交换盖尔范德表示定理

statement.natural_language: 每个含幺交换 C* 代数经盖尔范德变换等距 *-同构于其特征空间上的连续函数代数。
hypotheses: A is a commutative unital C*-algebra
Δ(A) is its character space with the weak-star topology
statement.conclusion: The Gelfand transform A→C(Δ(A)) is an isometric *-isomorphism.
statement.scope: Unital commutative variant; locally compact nonunital form is separate.

material_status.basis: Commutative Gelfand representation theorem.

aliases: 偶维球面切向量场零点定理

statement.natural_language: 每个偶维球面上的连续切向量场至少有一个零点。
hypotheses: v is a continuous tangent vector field on S^{2n}
statement.conclusion: There exists x∈S^{2n} with v(x)=0.
statement.scope: Even-dimensional spheres; odd-dimensional spheres have nowhere-zero tangent fields.

material_status.basis: Classical topological theorem.

aliases: 希尔伯特第十六问题第一部分

statement.natural_language: 对每个次数 d，分类非奇异实射影平面代数曲线实点集各连通分支的可能数目与相对位置。
hypotheses: d is a positive integer
C is a nonsingular real projective plane algebraic curve of degree d
statement.conclusion: Determine exactly all realizable topological arrangements of the connected components of C(R) for every d.
statement.scope: First, real-algebraic-curve part only; known degree-by-degree results do not close all d.

material_status.basis: Hilbert's original two-part problem remains only partially resolved in unbounded degree.

aliases: 希尔伯特第十六问题第二部分

statement.natural_language: 对每个次数 d，求平面 d 次多项式向量场孤立极限环数目的统一上界并分类其相对位置。
hypotheses: d is a positive integer
a planar polynomial vector field has degree at most d
statement.conclusion: Determine a finite sharp uniform bound H(d) for its isolated limit cycles and characterize possible configurations.
statement.scope: Second, polynomial-vector-field part only; not the first algebraic-curve part.

material_status.basis: No general solution or sharp uniform function H(d) is known.

statement.natural_language: 欧氏 n 维空间开集到同维欧氏空间的连续单射是开映射，并且是到其像的同胚。
hypotheses: U⊆R^n is open
f:U→R^n is continuous and injective
statement.conclusion: f(U) is open in R^n and f:U→f(U) is a homeomorphism.
statement.scope: Equal finite dimensions; codomain dimension is exactly n.

material_status.basis: Brouwer's invariance-of-domain theorem.

statement.natural_language: 特征零域上的多项式自映射若雅可比行列式为非零常数，则存在多项式逆映射。
hypotheses: k is a field of characteristic 0
F:k^n→k^n is a polynomial map
det JF is a nonzero constant
statement.conclusion: F is a polynomial automorphism of affine n-space.
statement.scope: All finite n; the n=1 case is elementary and higher dimensions remain open.

material_status.basis: The general characteristic-zero Jacobian conjecture remains unsolved.

statement.natural_language: 平面中的每条简单闭曲线把平面恰分成两个连通分支，并且曲线是两者的共同边界。
hypotheses: C⊂R² is the image of a continuous injective map S¹→R²
statement.conclusion: R²∖C has exactly two connected components, one bounded and one unbounded, and C is the boundary of each.
statement.scope: Topological Jordan curves; no smoothness assumption.

material_status.basis: Classical Jordan curve theorem.

aliases: 若尔当–舍恩弗利斯定理

statement.natural_language: 平面中的任意简单闭曲线嵌入都可扩张为整个平面的自同胚。
hypotheses: h:S¹→R² is a topological embedding
statement.conclusion: There exists a homeomorphism H:R²→R² whose restriction to S¹ (under the standard inclusion) equals h.
statement.scope: Planar Schoenflies extension; stronger than plane separation alone.

material_status.basis: Classical planar Schoenflies theorem.

aliases: 柯尔莫哥洛夫扩张定理
柯尔莫哥洛夫相容性定理

statement.natural_language: 标准 Borel 状态空间上的相容有限维分布族唯一确定乘积柱 σ-代数上的概率测度。
hypotheses: I is an index set
each E_i is a standard Borel space
for every finite J⊂I a probability μ_J on ∏_{j∈J}E_j is given
the μ_J are projectively consistent
statement.conclusion: There exists a unique probability μ on the product cylinder σ-algebra whose finite-dimensional marginals are μ_J.
statement.scope: Standard-Borel version; completion and path regularity are separate questions.

material_status.basis: Kolmogorov consistency/extension theorem.

statement.natural_language: 有限长度模可分解为有限个不可分解模的直和，且该分解在置换与同构意义下唯一。
hypotheses: M is a module of finite length
statement.conclusion: M has a finite indecomposable direct-sum decomposition, and any two such decompositions have the same number of terms matched up to permutation and isomorphism.
statement.scope: Finite-length module variant; broader categorical versions require separate hypotheses.

material_status.basis: Classical Krull-Schmidt theorem in a safe finite-length scope.

statement.natural_language: 局部可积函数在几乎处处的点等于其缩小球平均值的极限。
hypotheses: f∈L¹_loc(R^n)
statement.conclusion: For almost every x, lim_{r→0} |B(x,r)|^{-1}∫_{B(x,r)}|f(y)−f(x)|dy=0, hence the averages of f converge to f(x).
statement.scope: Euclidean balls and Lebesgue measure.

material_status.basis: Classical Lebesgue differentiation theorem.

statement.natural_language: 检验两个简单假设时，在给定显著性水平内，似然比阈值检验是最强力检验。
hypotheses: H₀ and H₁ are simple dominated hypotheses with densities p₀ and p₁
the likelihood-ratio test randomizes on a boundary if needed to have size α
statement.conclusion: Every test of size at most α has H₁-power no greater than the likelihood-ratio threshold test.
statement.scope: Simple-versus-simple hypotheses; composite extensions are separate results.

material_status.basis: Neyman-Pearson's primary result.

statement.natural_language: 若 n 个复数在 Q 上线性无关，则这些数及其指数共同生成的域在 Q 上的超越次数至少为 n。
hypotheses: z₁,…,z_n∈C are linearly independent over Q
statement.conclusion: trdeg_Q Q(z₁,…,z_n,e^{z₁},…,e^{z_n})≥n.
statement.scope: Classical complex-exponential formulation.

material_status.basis: The conjecture remains open; many standard transcendence conjectures follow from it.

statement.natural_language: 光滑射影 n 维簇上向量丛的第 i 上同调与其对偶扭正则层的第 n−i 上同调互为线性对偶。
hypotheses: X is a smooth projective n-dimensional variety over a field k
E is a vector bundle on X
ω_X is the canonical bundle
statement.conclusion: The trace pairing H^i(X,E)×H^{n−i}(X,E^∨⊗ω_X)→k is perfect.
statement.scope: Smooth-projective vector-bundle form; broader proper-duality statements are separate variants.

material_status.basis: Serre's coherent-sheaf duality theorem in a standard exact scope.

statement.natural_language: 赋范空间对偶的闭单位球在弱星拓扑下是紧的。
hypotheses: X is a real or complex normed space
B carries the weak-star topology σ(X*,X)
statement.conclusion: B is compact.
statement.scope: Closed dual unit ball; no reflexivity assumption.

material_status.basis: Alaoglu's weak-topology compactness theorem.

aliases: 费希尔–奈曼因子分解定理
充分统计量因子分解准则

statement.natural_language: 在可数参数的受控统计模型中，统计量 T 充分当且仅当各密度可分解为只经 T 依赖样本的参数项与参数无关项之积。
hypotheses: the sample space is standard Borel
Θ is finite or countable
{P_θ:θ∈Θ} is dominated by a σ-finite measure μ with densities f_θ
T is measurable
statement.conclusion: T is sufficient for Θ iff there exist measurable g_θ and a nonnegative measurable h independent of θ such that f_θ(x)=g_θ(T(x))h(x) μ-a.e. for every θ.
statement.scope: Countably indexed dominated version, chosen so simultaneous density versions are well-defined.

material_status.basis: Fisher 1922 is retained as historical provenance; the Halmos-Savage Radon-Nikodym treatment supports the modern dominated-experiment scope of the factorization criterion.

statement.natural_language: 对充分统计量取条件期望，在凸损失下不会增加估计风险。
hypotheses: T is sufficient for a statistical model {P_θ}
δ(X) is an integrable estimator taking values in a convex subset of a vector space
L(θ,a) is convex in a and the risks exist
δ*(T)=E_θ[δ(X)|T], whose version is parameter-independent by sufficiency
statement.conclusion: For every θ, E_θ[L(θ,δ*(T))]≤E_θ[L(θ,δ(X))].
statement.scope: Convex-loss risk form; strict improvement requires additional nondegeneracy/strict-convexity hypotheses.

material_status.basis: Rao-Blackwell conditional-expectation improvement theorem.

additions.preferred_label: Rao–Blackwell theorem for R^d-valued estimators — exact convex-loss form
aliases: 拉奥–布莱克韦尔定理（R^d 凸损失精确形式）

statement.natural_language: 在标准 Borel 统计模型中，用充分统计量的参数无关条件核对 R^d 值可积估计量取条件均值，在非负有限凸损失下不增加风险。
hypotheses: (X,A,{P_theta}) is a statistical model on a standard Borel sample space and T:X->Y is measurable into a standard Borel space
T is sufficient in the explicit kernel sense: there is one Markov kernel K(dx|t), independent of theta, that is a regular conditional distribution of X given T=t under every P_theta
delta:X->R^d is Borel measurable and E_theta[||delta(X)||]<infinity for every theta
For every theta, a->L(theta,a) is a finite nonnegative convex Borel function on R^d and E_theta[L(theta,delta(X))]<infinity
delta_star(t)=integral delta(x) K(dx|t), defined componentwise (equivalently as the finite-dimensional Bochner integral)
statement.conclusion: For every theta, E_theta[L(theta,delta_star(T))] <= E_theta[L(theta,delta(X))].
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional R^d-valued estimators with an explicitly shared sufficient kernel. Strict improvement, infinite-dimensional Banach-valued estimators and losses lacking the stated integrability require separate variants.

material_status.basis: The cited Rao and Blackwell sources establish conditional-expectation improvement; the finite-dimensional integrability and common-kernel hypotheses make the conditional Jensen step explicit.

statement.natural_language: 完备充分统计量的任意平方可积无偏函数是目标参数的唯一一致最小方差无偏估计量。
hypotheses: T is complete and sufficient for {P_θ}
U=g(T) is square-integrable
E_θ[U]=τ(θ) for every θ
statement.conclusion: U is the unique (up to model-null equality) uniformly minimum-variance unbiased estimator of τ among square-integrable unbiased estimators.
statement.scope: UMVU form; completeness and exact estimand are explicit.

material_status.basis: Lehmann-Scheffe completeness theorem.

aliases: 最小二乘最佳线性无偏定理

statement.natural_language: 在满列秩、同方差且误差不相关的线性模型中，普通最小二乘是协方差意义下最佳的线性无偏估计量。
hypotheses: y=Xβ+ε with deterministic n×p matrix X of rank p
Cov(ε)=σ²I_n with finite σ²
an estimator Ay is linear and unbiased for β, so AX=I_p
statement.conclusion: Cov(Ay)−Cov((XᵀX)^{-1}Xᵀy) is positive semidefinite.
statement.scope: Classical homoscedastic uncorrelated full-rank linear model.

material_status.basis: Classical Gauss-Markov BLUE theorem.

aliases: 经验分布函数一致收敛定理

statement.natural_language: 实值独立同分布样本的经验分布函数几乎必然一致收敛到真实分布函数。
hypotheses: X₁,X₂,… are i.i.d. real random variables with distribution function F
statement.conclusion: sup_{x∈R}|F_n(x)−F(x)|→0 almost surely.
statement.scope: Classical one-dimensional empirical-CDF form.

material_status.basis: Classical Glivenko-Cantelli theorem.

additions.preferred_label: Fundamental theorem of calculus, differentiation part
aliases: 微积分基本定理第一部分
积分上限函数求导定理

statement.natural_language: 连续函数从固定端点到变量端点的积分是该函数的一个原函数。
hypotheses: f:[a,b]→R is continuous
F(x)=∫_a^x f(t)dt
statement.conclusion: F is differentiable on (a,b) and F′(x)=f(x).
statement.scope: Continuous real-valued one-variable form.

material_status.basis: First direction of the fundamental theorem of calculus.

additions.preferred_label: Fundamental theorem of calculus, evaluation part
aliases: 微积分基本定理第二部分（牛顿–莱布尼茨公式）

statement.natural_language: 连续函数的定积分等于任一原函数在两端点取值之差。
hypotheses: f:[a,b]→R is continuous
A is differentiable on (a,b), continuous on [a,b], and A′=f on (a,b)
statement.conclusion: ∫_a^b f(x)dx=A(b)−A(a).
statement.scope: Continuous-integrand Newton-Leibniz form.

material_status.basis: Evaluation direction of the fundamental theorem of calculus.

statement.natural_language: C¹ 映射在导数可逆的点附近是 C¹ 微分同胚。
hypotheses: U⊆R^n is open
f:U→R^n is C¹
a∈U
Df(a) is invertible
statement.conclusion: There are neighborhoods V of a and W of f(a) such that f|_V:V→W is a C¹ diffeomorphism and D(f|_V)^{-1}(f(x))=(Df(x))^{-1}.
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional C1 version.

material_status.basis: Classical finite-dimensional inverse function theorem.

statement.natural_language: 若方程 F(x,y)=0 对 y 的偏导在解点可逆，则解集局部唯一地是 C¹ 图 y=g(x)。
hypotheses: F:U⊆R^n×R^m→R^m is C¹
D_yF(a,b) is invertible
statement.conclusion: There are neighborhoods V of a and W of b and a unique C¹ map g:V→W with F(x,g(x))=0, and every nearby zero has y=g(x).
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional C1 graph form.

material_status.basis: Classical finite-dimensional implicit function theorem.

statement.natural_language: 群同态的定义域模其核同构于其像。
hypotheses: φ:G→H is a group homomorphism
statement.conclusion: The map g kerφ↦φ(g) is a well-defined group isomorphism G/kerφ≅imφ.
statement.scope: Groups; ring/module analogues are separate variants.

material_status.basis: Classical group isomorphism theorem.

statement.natural_language: 若 H 是 G 的子群、N 是 G 的正规子群，则 H/(H∩N) 同构于 HN/N。
hypotheses: H≤G
N◁G
statement.conclusion: HN≤G, N◁HN, H∩N◁H, and h(H∩N)↦hN gives an isomorphism H/(H∩N)≅HN/N.
statement.scope: Standard subgroup-normal-subgroup version.

material_status.basis: Classical second isomorphism theorem.

statement.natural_language: 若 N 包含于 H 且二者都是 G 的正规子群，则 (G/N)/(H/N) 同构于 G/H。
hypotheses: N◁G
H◁G
N⊆H
statement.conclusion: H/N◁G/N and (G/N)/(H/N)≅G/H by the canonical map.
statement.scope: Groups; normality of H in G is explicit.
